messages.author: 0d0c8b26b90d9fd8
messages.subject: issue when using runMCMC
parts:
Hi, all. When I give the runMCMC code, I have one warning:
#warning: logProb of data node logT[957, 30]: logProb less than -1e12
I am wondering why I have this warning and if we can solve this floating issue. Thank you.

messages.author: c9e9cbbfb3b043f0
messages.subject: Re: issue when using runMCMC
parts:
Zhiduo, this might suggest that the model is not properly initialized.  Depending on the situation, the MCMC may or may not be able to initialize the model for you.  Are there any other warnings?  Do the posterior samples look reasonable?  Regardless, it might be a good idea to have the model properly initialized, before running the MCMC.

Without more details, it's difficult to say anything more.  I hope this helps.

Daniel

messages.author: c9e9cbbfb3b043f0
messages.subject: Re: issue when using runMCMC
parts: That's curious indeed about the seeds.  Sometimes in models with discrete layers of parameters, some initialization at a higher level can lead to impossible situations in lower levels, thus the warning you're seeing.  So my guess is that for some seeds, the automatic-initialization at the higher levels leads to impossible initialization at the lower levels, and that warnings.  But again, it would require looking carefully at your code.  For now, I would just suggest initializing all variables in the model.
